subject: Renewal evidence window: SOC 2 Type II timeframe and bridging options

Subject: SOC 2 coverage for renewal (Jan 15 2027) - docs needed

Hi Ben,

We're kicking off the contract renewal for AcmeApp (renewal date: 2027-01-15). Procurement asked me to confirm what SOC 2 Type II evidence Redwood can provide that covers our renewal window. Specifically:

- Latest Type II report (period covered and report date)
- Whether a bridge letter or interim attestation will be available if the current Type II doesn't cover up to Jan 15, 2027
- Any SIG/CAIQ artifacts you can surface for security review (or a pointer to where we can pull them)

I've attached our procurement checklist and ticketed the timeline we need (evidence by 2026-12-01 to keep our internal renewal cadence). Can you confirm?

Thanks — appreciate a quick read and plan so I can brief Procurement.

Best,
Hannah Lewis
Senior Procurement Manager 
AcmeApp

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage for renewal (Jan 15 2027) - docs needed

Hi all — quick summary from the compliance side:

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report: Issued 2026-07-15; report attests to controls operating from 2025-06-01 through 2026-05-31. File: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf (attached).
- Gap relative to AcmeApp renewal (2027-01-15): We do not currently have a Type II period that extends to Jan 2027. The gap is 2026-06-01 through 2027-01-15 (interim period).
- Bridge letter / interim attestation: We can provide a signed bridge letter that summarizes ongoing control posture and describes any material changes since the last Type II period. The bridge is typically accepted by procurement teams as interim coverage while the next audit completes, but acceptance is ultimately a customer decision — we'll tailor the language for AcmeApp. Draft: bridge-letter-template.docx (attached).
- SIG / CAIQ: We maintain a held SIG matrix and CAIQ responses in our secure drive. For procurement reviewers, I recommend the SIG index (summary table) plus three representative evidence items: network diagram, change management policy, and recent vulnerability scan summary. Links provided below.

Deliverables & timeline (can meet AcmeApp's Dec 1 ask if we prioritize):
- By 2026-11-18 EOD: deliver bridge letter draft + SOC 2 summary PDF + SIG index link.
- By 2026-11-25: finalized bridge letter with signature (if AcmeApp confirms it's acceptable).

Notes on scope and limitations: the bridge letter is an attestation of policy and control continuity; it is not a replacement for a Type II report and does not include auditor testing evidence. If Procurement wants auditor-signed interim workpapers, that will require coordination with the auditor and usually longer lead time.

Links / attachments:
- redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf (attached)
- bridge-letter-template.docx (attached)
- SIG/CAIQ folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/soc2-2026-pack

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call with AcmeApp's procurement/security team to walk through acceptance criteria.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Head of Security & Compliance 
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Thanks Monica — this is helpful and aligns with what Procurement needs. Two quick items:

1) Please send the bridge letter draft and the SOC 2 summary PDF to procurement@acmeapp.com by 2026-11-19 so our legal team can review and confirm acceptance.
2) Can you confirm whether the bridge letter will explicitly reference the audit period (2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31) and state that there have been no material control changes since the end of that period? Procurement prefers explicit statements.

If you can also share the SIG index link and the three representative evidence items you mentioned, that should keep our downstream teams happy. If the draft looks standard we can accept the bridge and proceed with renewal without delaying the Jan 15 date.

I'll block 11:00–11:30 PT on 2026-11-19 for a short call in case that's useful.

Best,
Hannah
